deals.evidence: Wanda Group acordó la compra del 20% del equipo de fútbol a cambio de una inyección de 45 millones
deals.headline: Wanda buys 20% of Atlético for EUR 45m
deals.summary: Wang Jianlin's Wanda Group took 20% in January 2015 for a EUR 45m injection (EUR 8.5 nominal plus EUR 53.4 premium per share), which Palco23 says valued 100% of the club at EUR 225m; Wanda later added EUR 15m for the academy, took the stadium naming rights (Wanda Metropolitano) and sold its stake to Quantum Pacific in February 2018 (Público).

deals.evidence: una operación que se articulará a través de una ampliación de capital de 50 millones de euros
deals.headline: Idan Ofer's Quantum Pacific takes 15% for EUR 50m in new shares
deals.summary: Capital increase of EUR 50m for a 15% holding, at EUR 8.5 nominal plus EUR 69.5 premium per share; Palco23 says the terms valued 100% of the club at EUR 333m (EUR 225m at Wanda's entry two years earlier). The club's statement was also carried by Diario AS.

deals.headline: Quantum Pacific buys Wanda's 17% and rises to 32%
deals.summary: Wanda sold its 17% to Quantum Pacific, taking Quantum to 32%; Gil Marín and Cerezo remained majority shareholders. Price not disclosed.

deals.evidence: que adoptan una participación del 33,96% del capital del accionista mayoritario del club
deals.headline: Ares backs Atlético HoldCo in the club's record EUR 181.8m capital increase
deals.summary: Gil Marín and Cerezo pooled their shares in Atlético HoldCo; Ares funds took 33.96% of HoldCo (close to 20% of the club, indirectly), and HoldCo put almost EUR 120m into the EUR 181.8m capital increase. Mark Affolter of Ares joined the HoldCo board. 2Playbook (2025) puts Ares's contribution across the 2021 and 2024 increases at about EUR 150m.

deals.evidence: ha obtenido un préstamo de 300 millones de euros de tres fondos estadounidenses
deals.headline: EUR 300m five-year refinancing from three US institutional lenders
deals.investor: Pricoa (Prudential), Barings and MetLife Investment Management
deals.summary: Prudential (through Pricoa) lent EUR 125m and Barings and MetLife EUR 175m, five-year maturity, to refinance more than EUR 200m owed to Inbursa; alongside the 2021 capital increase.

deals.evidence: por importe de 40.047.000 euros, que fue íntegramente suscrita por el referido socio
deals.headline: Partner takes 50% of Nasas Madrid, the Ciudad del Deporte real-estate company
deals.summary: On 4 June 2024 the club sold 50% of Nasas Madrid, S.A. to López Real Inversiones 2021, S.L.; on 19 June the club contributed a surface right over plot DS-05 (EUR 40.047m) and the partner subscribed a EUR 40.047m cash capital increase, 25% paid up and the rest due within five years. The company is jointly managed.

deals.evidence: lo que supone un total de 69.731.047,40 euros, a razón de 187,1 euros por acción
deals.headline: EUR 69.7m capital increase at EUR 187.1 a share
deals.summary: 372,694 new shares (EUR 8.5 nominal plus EUR 178.6 premium) approved on 24 June 2024; afterwards Atlético HoldCo held 70.47% and Quantum Pacific 27.84%.

deals.evidence: Apollo cerrará esta semana la compra de un 55% del Atlético
deals.headline: Apollo Sports Capital becomes Atlético's majority shareholder
deals.seller: Owners of Atlético HoldCo (Miguel Ángel Gil Marín, Enrique Cerezo, Ares Management funds)
deals.summary: Apollo's vehicle bought 100% of Atlético HoldCo and ended with about 55% of the club; Quantum Pacific kept substantially all of its stake as second-largest shareholder, and Gil Marín, Cerezo and Ares stayed on as direct shareholders. A source put the club's value at about EUR 2.5bn (FT via SportsPro: including debt); Forbes describes the price as roughly $2.95bn including debt. Gil Marín and Cerezo remain CEO and chairman.

deals.evidence: lo que eleva la ampliación de capital hasta el total de 101.068.366,73 euros
deals.headline: EUR 101m capital increase led by Apollo
deals.investor: Apollo Sports Capital (lead), with Quantum Pacific, Gil Marín and Cerezo
deals.summary: 305,589 new shares at EUR 330.733 each (EUR 8.5 nominal plus EUR 322.233 premium) for signings and the Ciudad del Deporte; the main shareholders subscribe to keep their weight. 2Playbook says it completes the agreements reached with Apollo, whose March 2026 release announced up to EUR 100m of additional equity and strategic capital.

name: Club Atlético de Madrid, S.A.D.
notes: Revenue is net turnover from the club's 2024-25 accounts (EUR 416.05m; 2023-24 EUR 395.1m); other operating income was EUR 31.3m and player-trading gains EUR 48.1m. The 2025-26 accounts (year to 30 June 2026) were not yet published. The accounts give no net-debt figure, so net_debt is blank; a 2021 Palco23 report put net debt then at EUR 590m (gross over EUR 870m), now out of date. Stakes after the Apollo deal are press figures (Mundo Deportivo, May 2026); 2Playbook and El Confidencial put Apollo at about 57%. Atlético's website (atleticodemadrid.com) sits behind a bot challenge, so the club's accounts are cited from the Wayback Machine copy. Forbes 2026 also lists revenue of $488m and owners Apollo Sports Capital, Idan Ofer and Ares Management. Not found: social follower counts, the club's tax ID (CIF).

ownership_summary: Since 12 March 2026 Apollo Sports Capital, the sports investment arm of Apollo Global Management, has been majority shareholder with about 55%: its vehicle Crimson Holdco bought 100% of Atlético HoldCo, the company through which CEO Miguel Ángel Gil Marín, chairman Enrique Cerezo and Ares funds held about 70% of the club. Per Mundo Deportivo (May 2026), Quantum Pacific (Idan Ofer) holds about 25%, Gil Marín about 10%, Cerezo about 3%, Ares Management funds about 5% and small shareholders about 2%; 2Playbook puts Apollo nearer 57%. The deal valued the club at about EUR 2.5bn including debt.
